purpose: Audit/refactor overlay to make human-factors causal grain explicit and prevent pilot-error flattening.

factor_axes.question: What was the aircraft/physical system actually doing?
What state cues or indications were available, unreliable, ambiguous, ignored, or misunderstood?
Did automation modes, warnings, autothrottle/autopilot state, or alerting create/resolve ambiguity?
Did communication, challenge, command gradient, or resource management convert individual observations into shared operational state?
Which training, procedure, record, or advisory-circular surfaces were supposed to preserve lessons?
Was fatigue, professionalism, supervision, or organizational oversight materially implicated by the investigator?
Which post-impact survival/evacuation surface is separate from accident causation?
What is safety-investigation status versus blame/liability/legal status?

refactor_actions: Added human-factors factor axes instead of creating a hard schema migration.
Added United 232 positive control to prevent one-sided pilot-error patterning.
Added BEA/Annex 13 rail to keep safety-causal and legal surfaces separate.
Added AF447 legal-status source-acquisition follow-through rather than promoting a current-news legal claim without official source.
